No phonology, tone or stress content; only Ethnologue population and classification references.

sources.citation: Schadeberg, Thilo C. 1981. A Survey of Kordofanian, vol. 1: The Heiban Group. Hamburg: Buske. Chapter 10 'Logol', pp. 99-ca. 105 (10.1 Phonological notes: vowels/tone paragraph).

sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: The sole primary description of Logol; its vowels-and-tone paragraph is the only place a stress or tone statement for Logol can exist. HathiTrust search-only copies (uva.x000876674 v.1; inu.30000006026789) would at least give page hits for 'stress'/'tone' from an unblocked IP; a library scan of pp. 99-105 would settle it.
